```{r}
#| label: 06-01-read
#| message: false
#| warning: false

library(tidyverse)

read_lines("simon-5507-06-demo1.sas") |>
  # str_remove("^\\* ") |>
  paste0(collapse="\n") |>
  str_split(pattern="\n\n\n") |>
  unlist() -> chunks
```

```{r}
#| label: parse-code-chunks

notes_string <- "^\\* Comments on the code: "
heads_string <- "^\\* "
semicolon <- ";"

notes <- str_detect(chunks, notes_string)
notes[1] <- FALSE # Don't confuse a documentation header for a note

chunks[notes] <- str_remove(chunks[notes], notes_string)
chunks[notes] <- str_remove(chunks[notes], semicolon)

heads <- str_detect(chunks, heads_string) & !notes
chunks[heads] <- str_remove(chunks[heads], heads_string)
chunks[heads] <- str_remove(chunks[heads], semicolon)

sas <- !notes & !heads
```

```{r}
#| label: prefixes-and-postfixes

chunks[heads] <- paste0(
  "\n\n## ",
  chunks[heads],
  "\n\n"
)

chunks[notes] <- paste0(
  "\n\n::: {.notes}\n\n",
  chunks[notes],
  "\n\n:::\n\n")

chunks[sas] <- paste0(
  "```{}\n",
  chunks[sas],
  "\n```\n\n"
)

```


```{r}
#| output: asis
cat("\n\n## Documentation header\n\n")
cat(chunks, sep="\n")
```
